description: Fetch one Brain memory by id. Content is either a singular fact or a short Markdown mini-doc (up to about 800 words). The memory includes addedBy (who first saved it) and versionCount (saved revisions). When versionCount is greater than 1, call get_memory_versions to read every saved revision.

brain.description: Brain id from list_brains. The personal brain is "personal".

name: get_memory
title: Get memory
